scripts.fmt: bunx nx run-many -t format && oxfmt -c .oxfmtrc.json scripts documentation/build.ts
scripts.bench:workflow: bun --conditions=@promin/source run packages/workflow/src/lib/durable/journaled-step.bench.ts && bun --conditions=@promin/source run packages/workflow/src/lib/durable/workflow-builder.bench.ts && bun --conditions=@promin/source run packages/workflow/src/lib/durable/runner/runner.bench.ts && bun --conditions=@promin/source run packages/workflow/src/lib/durable/steps/map-over-step.bench.ts
scripts.bench:all: bun run bench:dataframe && bun run bench:workflow && bun run bench
scripts.docs:dev: bun run documentation:build && bun run --filter @promin/docs dev
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules .nx/cache .nx/workspace-data .target packages/*/dist packages/*/dist-examples packages/*/dist-spec documentation/generator/.next documentation/generator/node_modules
scripts.build:release: bun run build:packages && bun run build:ui
scripts.fmt:check: bunx nx run-many -t format-check && oxfmt -c .oxfmtrc.check.json --check scripts documentation/build.ts
scripts.documentation:build:html: bun run documentation:build && bun run --filter @promin/docs build
scripts.ci: bun run fmt:check && bun run lint && bun run lint:scripts && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:scripts && bun run test:release && bun run test && bun run evals:ci && bun run documentation:check
